description: 20 s portrait launch piece for Grapla: SVG wordmark title over a p5 knowledge-graph background, a Three.js phone cycling three app screenshots with captions, and a GSAP end card. Assembled from four alpha PNG sequences with an FFmpeg overlay chain. The PRD §18 proving production, done without a timeline engine.
limitations: Silent; narration and music are Layer 5 work.
Scene timings are hand-placed in video.json and repeated in assemble.sh; the Layer 2 resolver should generate the tpad offsets.
Inline SVG styles beat stylesheet fills; the wordmark needed an !important override.
Capture speed at 1080x1920: p5 15 fps, GSAP 17 fps, Three 10 fps. Whole render about four minutes.
reuse_constraints: Grapla wordmark and screenshots are project-private; reuse the structure, not the assets.
Brand voice rules in projects/grapla/brand/brand.json apply to any copy change.
